mapper.insert: insert into second_comment ( second_comment_id, first_comment_id, account_id, comment_image_addr, comment_description, is_merchant_comment ) values( #{secondCommentId}, #{firstCommentId}, #{accountId}, #{commentImageAddr}, #{commentDescription}, #{merchantComment} );
mapper.select: select second_comment_id, first_comment_id, account_id, comment_image_addr, comment_description, create_time, like_amount, is_merchant_comment, is_delete from second_comment where first_comment_id=#{firstCommentId} and is_delete=false order by second_comment_id desc limit #{start},#{need}
mapper.update: update second_comment set is_delete=true where second_comment_id=#{commentId} and account_id=#{accountId} and is_delete=false
mapper.select: select comment_image_addr from second_comment where second_comment_id=#{commentId} and is_delete=true
mapper.update: update second_comment set like_amount=like_amount+#{changeNumber} where second_comment_id=#{commentId}
